segments.an5.30:1.1: Evaṃ me sutaṃ – ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā kosalesu cārikaṃ caramāno mahatā bhikkhusaṅghena saddhiṃ yena icchānaṅgalaṃ nāma kosalānaṃ brāhmaṇagāmo tadavasari.
segments.an5.30:1.3: Tatra sudaṃ bhagavā icchānaṅgale viharati icchānaṅgalavanasaṇḍe.
segments.an5.30:1.4: Assosuṃ kho icchānaṅgalakā [icchānaṅgalikā (sī.) a. ni.6.42; a. ni.8.86] brāhmaṇagahapatikā –
segments.an5.30:1.5: “samaṇo khalu bho gotamo sakyaputto sakyakulā pabbajito icchānaṅgalaṃ anuppatto; icchānaṅgale viharati icchānaṅgalavanasaṇḍe.
segments.an5.30:1.6: Taṃ kho pana bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ evaṃ kalyāṇo kittisaddo abbhuggato – itipi so bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho vijjācaraṇasampanno sugato lokavidū anuttaro purisadammasārathi, satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavāti.
segments.an5.30:1.8: So imaṃ lokaṃ sadevakaṃ samārakaṃ sabrahmakaṃ sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiṃ pajaṃ sadevamanussaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā pavedeti.
segments.an5.30:1.9: So dhammaṃ deseti ādikalyāṇaṃ majjhekalyāṇaṃ pariyosānakalyāṇaṃ sātthaṃ sabyañjanaṃ, kevalaparipuṇṇaṃ parisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ pakāseti.
segments.an5.30:1.10: Sādhu kho pana tathārūpānaṃ arahataṃ dassanaṃ hotī”ti.
segments.an5.30:1.11: Atha kho icchānaṅgalakā brāhmaṇagahapatikā tassā rattiyā accayena pahūtaṃ khādanīyaṃ bhojanīyaṃ ādāya yena icchānaṅgalavanasaṇḍo tenupasaṅkamiṃsu; upasaṅkamitvā bahidvārakoṭṭhake aṭṭhaṃsu uccāsaddamahāsaddā.
segments.an5.30:2.1: Tena kho pana samayena āyasmā nāgito bhagavato upaṭṭhāko hoti.
segments.an5.30:2.2: Atha kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ nāgitaṃ āmantesi –
segments.an5.30:2.3: “ke pana kho, nāgita, uccāsaddamahāsaddā, kevaṭṭā maññe macchavilope”ti?
segments.an5.30:2.4: “Ete, bhante, icchānaṅgalakā brāhmaṇagahapatikā pahūtaṃ khādanīyaṃ bhojanīyaṃ ādāya bahidvārakoṭṭhake ṭhitā bhagavantaññeva uddissa bhikkhusaṅghañcā”ti.
segments.an5.30:2.5: “Māhaṃ, nāgita, yasena samāgamaṃ, mā ca mayā yaso.
segments.an5.30:2.6: Yo kho, nāgita, nayimassa nekkhammasukhassa pavivekasukhassa upasamasukhassa sambodhasukhassa nikāmalābhī assa akicchalābhī akasiralābhī, yassāhaṃ nekkhammasukhassa pavivekasukhassa upasamasukhassa sambodhasukhassa nikāmalābhī akicchalābhī akasiralābhī.
segments.an5.30:2.7: So taṃ [sohaṃ (ka.), so (syā. kaṃ.)] mīḷhasukhaṃ middhasukhaṃ lābhasakkārasilokasukhaṃ sādiyeyyā”ti.
segments.an5.30:3.3: Yena yeneva dāni bhagavā gamissati taṃninnāva gamissanti brāhmaṇagahapatikā negamā ceva jānapadā ca.
segments.an5.30:3.4: Seyyathāpi, bhante, thullaphusitake deve vassante yathāninnaṃ udakāni pavattanti;
segments.an5.30:3.5: evamevaṃ kho, bhante, yena yeneva dāni bhagavā gamissati, taṃninnāva gamissanti brāhmaṇagahapatikā negamā ceva jānapadā ca.
segments.an5.30:4.1: “Māhaṃ, nāgita, yasena samāgamaṃ, mā ca mayā yaso.
segments.an5.30:4.2: Yo kho, nāgita, nayimassa nekkhammasukhassa pavivekasukhassa upasamasukhassa sambodhasukhassa nikāmalābhī assa akicchalābhī akasiralābhī, yassāhaṃ nekkhammasukhassa pavivekasukhassa upasamasukhassa sambodhasukhassa nikāmalābhī akicchalābhī akasiralābhī.
segments.an5.30:4.3: So taṃ mīḷhasukhaṃ middhasukhaṃ lābhasakkārasilokasukhaṃ sādiyeyya.
segments.an5.30:4.4: Asitapītakhāyitasāyitassa kho, nāgita, uccārapassāvo – eso tassa nissando.
segments.an5.30:4.6: Piyānaṃ kho, nāgita, vipariṇāmaññathābhāvā uppajjanti sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsā – eso tassa nissando.
segments.an5.30:4.8: Asubhanimittānuyogaṃ anuyuttassa kho, nāgita, subhanimitte pāṭikulyatā [paṭikkūlatā (sī.), paṭikkūlyatā (syā. kaṃ.)] saṇṭhāti – eso tassa nissando.
segments.an5.30:4.10: Chasu kho, nāgita, phassāyatanesu aniccānupassino viharato phasse pāṭikulyatā saṇṭhāti – eso tassa nissando.
segments.an5.30:4.12: Pañcasu kho, nāgita, upādānakkhandhesu udayabbayānupassino viharato upādāne pāṭikulyatā saṇṭhāti – eso tassa nissando”ti.

lines: Dasame uddhaṃ uggatattā ucco, rāsibhāvena ca mahā saddo etesanti uccāsaddamahāsaddā.

Tesu hi uggatuggatesu khattiyamahāsāla-brāhmaṇamahāsālādīsu mahāsakkāraṃ gahetvā āgatesu “asukassa okāsaṃ detha, asukassa okāsaṃ dethā”ti vutte “mayaṃ paṭhamataraṃ āgatā, mayhaṃ paṭhamataraṃ āgatā, natthi okāso”ti evaṃ aññamaññaṃ kathentānaṃ saddo ucco ceva mahā ca ahosi.
Tesañhi macchapacchiṃ gahetvā āgatānaṃ vikkiṇanaṭṭhāne “mayhaṃ detha mayhaṃ dethā”ti vadato mahājanassa evarūpo saddo hoti.
Taṃninnāva gamissantīti taṃ tadeva bhagavato gataṭṭhānaṃ gamissanti, anubandhissantiyevāti vuttaṃ hoti.
Tathā hi, bhante, bhagavato sīlapaññāṇanti yasmā tathāvidhaṃ tumhākaṃ sīlañca ñāṇañcāti attho.
Mā ca mayā yasoti mayā saddhiṃ yasopi mā samāgacchatu.
Eso tassa nissandoti esā tassa asubhanimittānuyogassa nipphatti.
Evamimasmiṃ sutte imesu pañcasu ṭhānesu vipassanāva kathitāti.
Dasame uccāsaddamahāsaddāti uddhaṃ uggatattā ucco patthaṭo mahanto vinibbhijjitvā gahetuṃ asakkuṇeyyo saddo etesanti uccāsaddamahāsaddā.
Vacīghosopi hi bahūhi ekajjhaṃ pavattito atthato saddato ca duravabodho kevalaṃ mahānigghoso eva hutvā sotapathamāgacchati.
Macchavilopeti macchānaṃ vilumpitvā viya gahaṇe, macchānaṃ vā vilumpane.
Kevaṭṭānañhi macchapacchiṭhapitaṭṭhāne mahājano sannipatitvā “idha aññaṃ ekaṃ macchaṃ dehi, ekaṃ macchaphālaṃ dehī”ti,“etassa te mahā dinno, mayhaṃ khuddako”ti evaṃ uccāsaddaṃ mahāsaddaṃ karonti.
Macchaggahaṇatthaṃ jāle pakkhittepi tasmiṃ ṭhāne kevaṭṭā ceva aññe ca “paviṭṭho gahito”ti mahāsaddaṃ karonti.
